name: boost
description: A memory and disk utility for macOS that tells you the truth. Pause apps instead of closing them, reclaim disk space that is genuinely safe to reclaim.

paragraphs: A free, open source Mac app for memory and disk space. It lives in your menu bar, shows what is using your RAM, freezes apps you are not using, and finds caches and leftovers that are safe to remove.
If you have looked at CleanMyMac, iStat Menus or AppCleaner and did not want a subscription, this covers the parts most people actually use.
Or build it yourself, which takes about as long and involves no Gatekeeper at all:
